headline: The shop is closed Mondays. A few map cards still open the door Monday morning.
summary: This is a real trailer manufacture and repair shop at 11919 Woodside Ave in Lakeside. Vic, Chris, and Allie already show up in the reviews. Google Maps is live this week at 4.4 stars, closed Mondays, opens Tuesday at 7. The shop this week prints fetrailers@mac.com and (619) 444-9932. Shop-owned hours print Tuesday through Friday 7 to 5, Saturday and Sunday closed, which means Monday is closed too. Loc8NearMe matches that week. BusinessYab and a few other directories still print Monday 7 to 5:30. A neighbor with a bent axle can tow in on Monday and find a locked gate that the leftover card promised was open.

signals.note: You show up for trailer manufacture and repair in Lakeside. Google Maps is live this week at 4.4 stars. Reviews already name Vic, Chris, and Allie. A neighbor looking for axles, bunks, lights, or a custom boat trailer can find you.
signals.next: Keep the category trailer manufacture and repair in Lakeside. Stay on Woodside Ave so the yard and the listing match.
